text_block_list.text:
One day, while out and about with Eishin
Flash...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Look, they have Umamusume plushies as
prizes.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I look in the direction Эйсин Флэш is
pointing and
see a claw machine filled
with Umamusume
plushies.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
There is a glaring absence of detail, but
the cute
features on them are rather
endearing.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list: Do you want to give the game a try?

text_block_list.text:
No. There is a large obstacle to winning
this
game, and that is the machine itself.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Despite the necessity of precise
operation down
to the millimeter in
order to win a prize, the
control system
is very inaccurate.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Worse, the claw's flawed design makes
grasping
objects incredibly inefficient.
Such conditions are
grossly unfair.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list: I'll give it a shot instead, then!

text_block_list.text:
You do seem rather confident. Very
well, I entrust
you with this endeavor.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Теперь я ни за что не могу подвести!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
